goals.title: 20 research notes with verified places
goals.summary: Expand the map across animals, plants and fungi, starting with the gaps in our existing library.
goals.acceptance: Each mapped note needs a cited study-region or animal-origin passage, a review date and an approximate public locator. More pins alone do not establish stronger evidence.
goals.next_step: The coverage target is reached. Deepen methods review for mapped abstracts and resolve the remaining unmapped records; more dots alone are not stronger evidence.
goals.action: Suggest a source or location correction

goals.title: Three historical source notes
goals.summary: Learn from work published before 2000, alongside modern machine learning.
goals.acceptance: Three distinct notes with original sources published before 2000, explicit review depth and clear separation of observation and publication dates.
goals.next_step: The three-note target is reached. Obtain the unreviewed original methods and continue checking later reassessments; historical year labels identify the original study, not every later citation.

goals.title: One reviewed, passive parrot pilot
goals.summary: Turn the provisional budgerigar idea into one answerable question with a workable recording protocol.
goals.acceptance: Confirmed species and carer access, avian specialist review, consent, independent behavior labels and a successful physical-phone rehearsal. No recruitment or approval is claimed yet.
goals.next_step: Resolve access and reviewer availability, then revise the existing draft protocol before admitting real recordings.

goals.title: A protected first observation release
goals.summary: Eventually connect volunteered observations to studies, evidence and this atlas.
goals.acceptance: An approved protocol, reviewed consent and data rights, tested private storage and withdrawal, human review, and a separate public export that protects homes and sensitive wildlife sites.
goals.next_step: Complete the existing hosted-storage and consent gates. Public map sharing must be optional and separately reviewed.
